profile.headline: Consultant, Backend Developer at Avanade
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: As a software engineer, I take advantage of the fast-paced nature of the field by staying up-to-date with current technologies, practicing existing skills, and devoting time to pick up additional skills along the way. At present, I am deeply interested in backend development and its subsets including AI technologies, microservices, and cloud services such as AWS and GCP.

positions.title: Backend Developer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
Developed a financial dashboard based on provided acceptance criteria in the Agile development methodology under the DCX team for an energy solutions client
Used C# to develop backend logging capabilities, and queried the logs in Application Insights using KQL
Engaged with the team via daily standup meetings to provide updates on project progress, and receive feedback to facilitate maximization of the project’s customer value
Presented my work to the team’s project managers and lead IT specialist
